statement_summary: One group program aligned to CSF 2.0 meeting PCI DSS, the Safeguards Rule, and COPPA
Group CISO accountable; Qualified Individual and children's program coordinator designated in writing
Annual SP 800-30 risk analysis per division with roll-up to group
Risk acceptance authority by level; safety and card exposure risks at High must be treated
Supplements may not weaken group policy; re-align within 90 days; acquired businesses within 6 months
Divisions document common control inheritance annually
Service provider review, contract safeguards, and written assurances for children's information
Owner acknowledgment and responsibility matrix for every managed hotel
Annual common control assessment and division samples feed the Qualified Individual report
Exceptions risk-rated and time-limited; Qualified Individual approval for MFA or encryption alternatives
AI systems registered and approved under the Group AI Standard
Unique identities; legacy POS local accounts a documented exception until retirement
Least privilege; card display by business need; integrations limited to needed fields
MFA for Restricted data, CDE, and remote access; finance subsidiary MFA for all
Service accounts owned, governed, secrets in the store, 90-day rotation, never cached on endpoints
Access disabled within 4 hours of termination; seasonal staff at the last shift
Quarterly certification including privileged, service, and legacy POS accounts
Just-in-time privileged access through PAM
Vendor access only through PAM; no always-on vendor tools; ride control sessions approved
MFA offered to loyalty, passholder, and owner accounts; required for owner payment changes
Report suspected incidents within 1 hour; stop using tampered terminals
One group severity scale and playbooks
Clock start dates recorded per regime (FTC discovery, state determination, acquirer terms)
Acquirer notice and forensic investigator; owners notified as merchants of record
Notification matrix owned by Group General Counsel; reviewed quarterly
FTC notice within 30 days of discovery for 500 or more consumers
Escalation to the disclosure committee within 24 hours; Form 8-K Item 1.05 within 4 business days of materiality
Safety first: ride and lock incidents escalated to engineering
Annual cross-division exercise with acquirer, owner, FTC, and materiality decisions
Encrypt Restricted information in transit and at rest; Qualified Individual approval for alternatives
Card data only as tokens or in SYS-G4; never in email or forms; no security codes
Purpose tags in the guest profile hub; cross-division use only when the notice discloses it; no bank data in the hub
Children's information in its own store; separate consent and written assurances for disclosure
Retention schedule (guest register, ID numbers, profiles, templates, child profiles, inventory records, customer information)
Disposal makes Restricted information unreadable, including consumer reports
Immutable backups in a separate provider with restore tests
Training at hire and yearly; phishing simulations and reporting
Role-based training for front desk, outlet, gate, gallery, and loan staff
Card handling rules and terminal inspection
Quote total price including mandatory fees first in every channel
Approved generative AI tools only; human review before external use
Building systems in hardening scans; vendor defaults changed before go-live
Owner responsibility matrix and management agreement security terms
Ride and show control isolated; one-way maintenance path with approval
Written children's information security program and retention policy
Payment pages only with script inventory and tamper monitoring
Safeguards Rule supplement: MFA, encryption, testing, vendor oversight, FTC notice
Contingency plan restore test each year
Inventory reservation decision records kept 5 years
